glosses: to conceptualize (to conceive the idea for something)
Produire un concept, faire abstraction de la réalité pour concevoir une idée plus générale.
To interpret a phenomenon by forming a concept.

examples.text: Medicine today conceptualizes the heart as a machine.
Conceptualized as a neurological difference, autism is viewed as part of human diversity (Cherewick & Matergia, 2024; Taboas et al., 2023).

glosses: To conceive the idea for something.

examples.text: EconBiz was established as part of the Virtuelle Fachbibliotheken, a network of subject-related online portals conceptualized in the late 1990s and funded by the German Research Foundation (DFG).
